faqs.q: Can one product have several printing methods?
faqs.a: Yes. Add multiple printing types to the same product and let shoppers choose.

faqs.q: Can each method have its own price?
faqs.a: Yes. Pricing is set per printing method.

faqs.q: Can I limit colors for a method?
faqs.a: Yes. Set colors, size ranges and design restrictions for each method.

faqs.q: Can I charge more for bigger prints?
faqs.a: Yes. Set a printing price for each size range, so larger prints can cost more.
